newsitem.title: CANADA: Scotiabank offers to buy Ntl Trustco.
newsitem.headline: Scotiabank offers to buy Ntl Trustco.

text.p: Bank of Nova Scotia said on Tuesday that it would offer to acquire National Trustco Inc in a cash and stock deal valued at C$1.25 billion.
Canada's fourth biggest bank said that it would offer 0.125 of a common share plus C$26.475 for each common share of National Trustco.
Scotiabank said it already owned 2.4 percent of National Trustco and had lockup agreements for 47 percent of the company's outstanding common shares.
It said the offer would be available to shareholders until July 31 and was subject to regulatory approvals.

Scotiabank said there was no minimum offer for tendering the shares, but said that if 90 percent of National Trustco's shares were tendered, the bank intended to acquire the rest under the provisions of the Ontario Business Corporations Act.
"We see the acquisition of National Trust as an excellent fit strategically for both institutions," Scotiabank Chief Executive Peter Godsoe said in a statement.
